`last_finished_sentence_end()` finds the sentence with `text.lastIndexOf(last)`. That lands too late if the unfinished tail repeats the last sentence word for word, for example "Yes. And yes. And yes." followed by more words. This is rare. Adding up the lengths of the split sentences would be exact.

`open_bubbles` holds on to a bubble even after it leaves the DOM. A merge into it then runs `$box.el.append(last)`, which re-attaches it (`Chat.js` `speak()` and `chat()`). If anything ever clears the box without dropping the map, the old bubble would come back. Checking `last.isConnected` in `mergeable()` would close this.
